subject: Devtools Weekly #218: type checkers, a new build cache, and 3 launches
body_text:
This week: a side-by-side of four Python type checkers on a 400k-line monorepo, a look at the new content-addressed build cache in Bazel 8, and three launches from readers.

Also inside: why flaky-test quarantines keep coming back, and a short interview on on-call rotations at small teams.

Read the full issue online. You are receiving this because you subscribed at devtoolsweekly.email.
